name: halo-v2
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; NODE_V="$(nvm version default)"; if [ "$NODE_V" = "N/A" ]; then NODE_V="$(nvm version node)"; fi; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$NODE_V/bin:$PATH"; COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 corepack prepare pnpm@12.1.0 --activate && corepack pnpm install && node node_modules/electron/install.js
start: set -euo pipefail; : "${HALO_GCP_SA_KEY:?HALO_GCP_SA_KEY is required}"; install -d -m 700 "$HOME/.config/gcloud"; (umask 177; printf '%s' "$HALO_GCP_SA_KEY" > "$HOME/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json")

terminals.name: halo-dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; NODE_V="$(nvm version default)"; if [ "$NODE_V" = "N/A" ]; then NODE_V="$(nvm version node)"; fi; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$NODE_V/bin:$PATH"; HALO_USE_SWIFTSHADER=1 corepack pnpm dev
terminals.description: Control plane, workspace server, and Electron client. Forces nvm node (>=22.19) ahead of any shadowing PATH entry and runs the stack with SwiftShader for the headless renderer.

terminals.name: agentation-mcp
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; NODE_V="$(nvm version default)"; if [ "$NODE_V" = "N/A" ]; then NODE_V="$(nvm version node)"; fi; export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$NODE_V/bin:$PATH"; AGENTATION_STORE=memory npx -y agentation-mcp server --port 4747
terminals.description: Agentation HTTP server so the dev toolbar can sync annotation notes
